note: Everything here is provisional. Canon is never minted in a concept register; the implementation audit censuses the catalog and adjudicates exact ids.

flags.note: Beacon routes every navigation (cards, sub-links, manager blocks, breadcrumbs, attention items, recents, search results) through PM2.route dest objects — one navigate family, no per-destination command ids needed.

Selection payload must be {rid} and the handler must re-resolve the rid for sectionId at landing time; the hash grammar drops sectionId, so any command that replays a landing from the URL alone under-specifies the target.

Needs a defined fallback for unknown setting ids: Beacon shows an honest 'not in this project's settings' surface (stale export / version skew) instead of a blank or crash. The command contract should name that terminal state.
preview/apply/rollback exercised through PM2.copy verbatim (copy-preview, copy-apply, copy-rollback triggers). No new ids; flag that apply must stay token-addressed (stale tokens refuse honestly).

Install-family triggers exercised: install-scan, install-select, install-update (ask-first), install-repair; verify remains a receipt-only step here. Manual-only installations refuse with the ownership reason rather than no-op.

families_exercised_note: navigation (home/dest/manager/setting/search/all/copy via PM2.route.go exclusively); values (store.setValue for toggle/select/number/slider/text/multiselect with validation-error surfacing); search (query + rid landing + back-restore, 24 recorded cases); providers (refresh/reconnect/invoke-test/install family/setup.cursor-cli); copy (preview/apply/rollback walked end-to-end); states triggers via the shared drawer and quick actions.
